blocks.text: Allergies is wajah se hoti hain ke immune system un kamzor antigens ke liye hadd se zyada hassas (hypersensitive) ho jata hai jin se aksar logon mein koi immune response nahin hota. Allergy paida karne wale maadde allergens kehlate hain, maslan gard (dust), phaphoond (molds), phoolon ka zar (pollen), billi ki jild ke zarre (cat dander), kuch khane aur kuch dawaen (jaise penicillin).

Allergen ka saamna hone ke baad kuch log aik qism ki antibody banate hain jise E-antibodies kehte hain. Yeh antibodies mast cells se jur jati hain (mast cells aam taur par khoon ki naliyon ke gird connective tissue mein hote hain). Mast cells histamines chhorte hain jo inflammatory response shuru karti hain. Is se khoon ki naliyan phail jati hain, maya bahar risne lagta hai, aur doosri tabdeeliyan hoti hain jaise chheenkein, naak behna, kharish waghaira. Kuch logon mein histamines jaan lewa anaphylactic shock paida kar sakti hain, jis mein soojan ki wajah se saans lena mushkil ho jata hai. Aam allergies ke ilaaj mein antihistamine dawaen shamil hain jo histamines ko rok kar waqti aaraam deti hain. Bohat si allergies ka ilaaj mareezon ko antigens ke extracts (arq) ke teeke laga kar bhi kiya jata hai. Is ilaaj ko desensitization kehte hain. Is tareeqe se khoon mein G-antibodies banti hain. Jab allergen jism mein aata hai to E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle hi G-antibodies use khatam kar deti hain.

blocks.alt: Aik qataar: allergen B-cell se jurta, jo plasma cell ban kar E-antibodies chhorta; E-antibodies apne tane se mast cell par jurti; jab allergen in se jurta to mast cell histamines chhorta jo alamaat (symptoms) paida karti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Allergen B-cell se milta hai; B-cell plasma cell ban kar E-antibodies banata hai; E-antibodies mast cell par lag jati hain; dobara allergen aane par mast cell histamines chhorta hai, aur histamines alamaat (symptoms) paida karti hain.

Autoimmune bimariyan tab hoti hain jab immune system jism ke apne cells aur bairooni cheezon mein farq nahin kar pata. Is soorat mein immune system jism ke apne cells aur tissues par hamla kar ke unhein tabah karta hai. Kuch autoimmune bimariyan yeh hain:

items: Myasthenia gravis (MG) muscles ki kamzori ki bimari hai jis mein mareez apne hi skeletal muscle cells par lage acetylcholine receptors ke khilaf antibodies banate hain. Antibodies muscle ke receptors se jur jati hain, is liye muscles acetylcholine ka jawab nahin dete aur nerve impulse (asab ka paigham) muscle tak nahin pohanch pata.
Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) aisi autoimmune bimari hai jis mein mareez apne hi connective tissues aur bare aaza (organs) ke khilaf antibodies banata hai.
Rheumatoid arthritis: arthritis (jorron ki bimari) ki is qism mein mareez jorron ke cartilage wale tissue ke khilaf antibodies banata hai jo unhein nuqsan pohanchati hain.

Type I diabetes (Juvenile diabetes, kam umri ki diabetes) aisi autoimmune bimari hai jis mein antibodies pancreas ke insulin banane wale cells ko tabah kar deti hain. Autoimmune bimariyon ke ilaaj ki zyada tar dawaen poori immunity ko hi daba (suppress kar) deti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “Systemic Lupus Erythematosis” likhti hai. Bimari ka sahi naam systemic lupus erythematosus hai.

Aam taur par immune system ke T aur B cells sirf bairooni molecules aur cells par hamla kar ke unhein maarte hain. Is ki wajah yeh hai ke har shakhs ke cells ki satah par self-proteins hote hain. Self-proteins ka har shakhs ka khaas set molecular “fingerprints” (pehchan ke nishan) jaisa hai jise us ke apne T aur B cells pehchante hain.

Identical twins (hamshakal judwan) ke self-proteins 100% milte hain. Sab se achha mel khandan ke andar hi milta hai. Transplant ke liye tarjeeh ki tarteeb yeh hai: identical twin > behan/bhai (sibling) > maa/baap (parent) > ghair rishtedaar (unrelated donor). Ghair rishtedaar donor ke recipient se milne ka imkaan 1,00,000 se 2,00,000 mein se 1 hai.
blocks.title: Donor ka mel

blocks.text: Jab kisi shakhs ko transplant ke zariye koi uzv (organ) lagaya jata hai to mumkin hai ke diye gaye uzv ke self-proteins lene wale (recipient) ke self-proteins se na milte hon. Nateeje mein recipient ke T cells lagaye gaye uzv ke cells par hamla kar sakte hain aur B cells us ke proteins ke khilaf antibodies bana sakte hain. Is masle ko transplant rejection kehte hain. Rejection kam karne ke liye doctor aisa donor dhoondte hain jis ke self-proteins recipient se jitna ho sake milte hon. Woh aisi dawaen bhi dete hain jo lagaye gaye uzv ke khilaf recipient ke immune system ko daba deti hain. Lekin yeh dawaen infections se larne ki salahiyat bhi kam kar deti hain.

Transplant rejection rokne ke do tareeqe hain. Aik tareeqe mein monoclonal antibodies se un T cells ko tabah kiya jata hai jo transplant par hamla karte hain. Doosre tareeqe mein stem cells se naya immune system banaya jata hai jo transplant ko apna (self) samajhta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki numbering
blocks.text: Kitab ne 'Autoimmune Diseases' aur 'Transplant Rejection' dono ko '2-' number diya hai; Roman Urdu mein tarteeb ke mutabiq Transplant Rejection ko 3- likha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Allergy ke teekon (desensitization) se allergy kyun kam hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: In se khoon mein G-antibodies banti hain jo allergen ko mast cells par lagi E-antibodies tak pohanchne se pehle hi khatam kar deti hain, is liye kam histamine nikalti hai.

items: Allergy: kamzor antigens ke liye hypersensitivity; E-antibodies mast cells se jurti hain, mast cells histamines chhorte hain; ilaaj antihistamines aur desensitization (G-antibodies).
Autoimmune: myasthenia gravis, SLE, rheumatoid arthritis, Type I diabetes.
Transplant rejection: self-proteins na milein to T cells aur B cells hamla karte hain; mel wala donor, immunity dabane wali dawaen, monoclonal antibodies, stem cells.
